highlight_subsections.summary: This release completes the removal of V0 engine. V0 engine code including AsyncLLMEngine, LLMEngine, MQLLMEngine, all attention backends, and related components have been removed. **V1 is the only engine in the codebase now.**

highlight_subsections.summary: This releases turns on **FULL_AND_PIECEWISE as the CUDA graph mode default**. This should provide better out of the box performance for most models, particularly fine-grained MoEs, while preserving compatibility with existing models supporting only PIECEWISE mode.
